claim.value: Reduction must stop at the end of day 9 even if another stopping condition has not been reached.
claim.scope: Time bound on the proposed reduction search.

provenance.rationale: P016 makes the end of day 9 an independent alternative stopping condition.

signal_basis.value: The search retains reductions that repeatedly reproduce failure and continues partitioning them, subject to stopping when no single-component removal preserves failure, further reductions are unsafe or infeasible, or day 9 ends.
signal_basis.scope: Continuation and termination of the proposed reduction search; the deadline applies regardless of further reproducible reductions.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the reproduction-based continuation rule and all three alternative stopping conditions.
The claim states an explicit procedural deadline and requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim is licensed by the operation's explicit stopping rule. Reaching the end of day 9 independently requires termination; neither minimality nor unsafe or infeasible further reduction must first be established.
uncertainty: None material to this procedural time bound.
